project: Adaptive Supply Chain Cyber Defense Using GAN-Generated Attack Scenarios and Reinforcement Learning

features.description: Discovers, validates, and concatenates CIC-IDS2017 CSV files from directory, checking header integrity and schema conformance.
features.input: Directory of raw CSV files (e.g., data/raw/*.csv)
features.output: Pandas DataFrame with canonical 79 network flow columns
features.known_limitation: Requires identical header formats across raw CSV partitions.

features.description: Cleans infinite and NaN values, removes non-generalizable network identifiers (IPs, Ports, Timestamps), applies variance filter and collinearity filter (r > 0.98), and fits StandardScaler strictly on training split.
features.output: Preprocessed DataFrame with 71 continuous features + Label, and saved scaler.joblib
features.known_limitation: Feature selection is fixed to Pearson correlation and variance thresholds.

features.description: Partitions dataset into 70% Train (3,437), 15% Validation (736), and 15% Test (737) using stratified sampling to preserve rare attack class distributions.
features.output: train.csv (3,437 rows), val.csv (736 rows), test.csv (737 rows)
features.known_limitation: Extreme minority classes (e.g., Web Attack) have very low counts in test partition (1 sample).

features.description: Executes 13 automated assertions validating split proportions, zero data leakage, column counts, and absence of non-finite representations.
features.input: Paths to train.csv, val.csv, test.csv, scaler.joblib, feature_list.json
features.output: ValidationReport object and JSON summary report
features.known_limitation: Requires all artifact files to exist on disk prior to execution.

features.description: Trains Conditional Tabular GAN (SDV CTGANSynthesizer) strictly on the 3,437-row real training split for 25 epochs with discriminator steps and PacGAN packing (pac=10).
features.known_limitation: Local CPU training duration is ~45 seconds on 3,437 samples; scaling to full 2.8M records requires multi-GPU cluster.

features.description: Generates 2,000 synthetic attack records with numerical bounds enforcement, NaN filtering, and feature clamping.
features.input: Trained CTGAN checkpoint and sample count (2,000)
features.verified_result: Generated 2,000 synthetic samples (Benign 25.8%, DoS 19.1%, PortScan 14.5%, DDoS 13.2%, BruteForce 12.2%, Botnet 8.3%, WebAttack 6.9%)
features.known_limitation: Features with sharp spikes near 0 show mode-concentration characteristics.

features.description: Measures 1st Wasserstein distance, Jensen-Shannon divergence, Pearson correlation similarity, and mode collapse across 71 continuous features.
features.input: Real training DataFrame (3,437 rows) and Synthetic DataFrame (2,000 rows)
features.verified_result: PASSED (7 tests in 0.82s). Measured W1 = 0.1057 (pass < 0.25), Correlation = 98.69%, JS Divergence = 0.5117 (soft warning)
features.known_limitation: Heavy-tailed distributions trigger a soft warning on JS divergence (> 0.5000).

features.description: Trains Model A (Real Only, 3,437 rows) vs Model B (Augmented, 5,437 rows) and evaluates both on untouched held-out test split (737 rows).
features.verified_result: Model A Accuracy: 78.70%, Model B Accuracy: 80.19% (+1.49% delta). Macro-F1 delta: -0.0100 (0.1372 -> 0.1272)
features.known_limitation: Test split has only 1 Web Attack and 2 Botnet samples; single-sample misclassification severely penalizes Macro-F1.

features.feature_name: Network Flow to Supply Chain Threat Mapper
features.description: Translates continuous network flow metrics (duration, packets, TCP flags) into 4-stage supply chain scenarios with calibrated propagation risk, severity, and duration.
features.input: Flow record dictionary and attack label
features.known_limitation: Mapping uses expert-calibrated heuristic rules rather than dynamic CVE telemetry.

features.description: SQLAlchemy ORM layer storing and querying mapped attack scenarios from SQLite database.
features.input: SQL queries with category, source, and limit filters
features.output: List of Scenario records from data/scenarios.db
features.verified_result: Returns 5 scenarios with real IDs, severity, affected_stage, and impact vectors
features.known_limitation: SQLite database is single-file; concurrent write throughput is limited.

features.feature_name: Gymnasium Supply Chain Cyber Defense Environment
features.description: Custom Gymnasium environment simulating a 4-stage software pipeline (Supplier, Build, Registry, Deployment) with 12-dim state, 5 actions, inter-stage compromise propagation, and availability-based reward.
features.known_limitation: Discrete-event simulation in Python; does not execute live pod terminations on a physical Kubernetes cluster.

features.description: Deterministic baseline evaluating supply-chain health and risk sequentially to select actions (Recover, Rebuild, Block, Isolate, Monitor). Evaluated as benchmark Experiment A.
features.verified_result: PASSED (9 tests in 0.38s). Multi-seed benchmark: 30% mitigation, 99.92% availability across seeds [42, 123, 456, 789, 1024]
features.known_limitation: Fixed thresholds cannot dynamically adapt to novel attack variations.

features.description: Stable-Baselines3 DQN agent mapping 12-dim observations to defensive Q-values using MLP architecture with experience replay and target network updates.
features.output: Defensive action integer and Q-value estimates
features.verified_result: PASSED (7 tests in 1.15s). Verified loadable checkpoint with num_timesteps = 1000
features.known_limitation: Checkpoint is a 1,000-step architectural smoke test; full 50,000-step convergence training is ongoing.

features.description: Stable-Baselines3 PPO actor-critic agent for policy gradient optimization in discrete action spaces.
features.known_limitation: Architecture and Gym wrapper implemented; hyperparameter tuning actively ongoing.

features.symbol: FastAPI app instance and router mounts
features.description: REST API exposing simulation control (/api/simulation/reset, /api/simulation/step), defense inference (/api/defense/predict), scenario catalog (/api/scenarios), and health telemetry (/api/health).
features.known_limitation: Single-worker uvicorn configuration on local development port.

features.description: Responsive React + TypeScript + Vite web dashboard adhering to Apple HIG (20px container radii, 14px inner radii, WCAG AA contrast, connected pipeline topology, zero marketing percentages).
features.output: Rendered DOM with live WebSocket/REST telemetry
features.artifact: frontend/dist/ (production bundle: 728 KB JS, 15 KB CSS)
features.verified_result: Built client environment for production in 143ms with 0 errors
features.known_limitation: Faculty demo runner and demo-specific routes remain permanently removed.
